question: In a certain code language, ‘FATHER’ is written as ‘ETRHFA’ and ‘GALAXY’ is written as ‘XLYAGA’. How will ‘HABITS’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• In FATHER → ETRHFA 

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fdb5fabeda7e1ae38c062490cd83f5a115bdd977eabed96a73e5df63d224f40.png] .​​​ 
 
 

 

 
• In GALAXY → XLYAGA ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae7a6ce87335320a492fe33682c51115bd19e600f6f0316ee6dc3e4802145e36.png] 
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, In HABITS → ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53101f108381822b1d46a88d3424c0b984407e28439e8a245d77458c43670a3f.png] 
 
 

We get 'TBSIHA'.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
